excerpt: Welcome! Welcome! You are about to embark on a journey to a place that has been alternately referred to as the Oasis, the Metaverse, and The Matrix. Before you proceed, suit up with the following armour: - Read the class syllabus and schedule. - Get a Google Cardboard headset that works with your phone. - Join the class Facebook group. - Read about how to turn in assignments in the class Blackboard site. - Fill out the class survey so I know where you're starting from. - Sign up for Innovation Lab access. - Get inspired by outstanding projects completed by previous students. And see final projects from the last semester below.
